No github_ SSH key in ~/.ssh/, no ssh-agent holding a key, and the project
remote does not use an ssh-config alias bound to GitHub.
Git push operations will NOT work without SSH keys.

To set up GitHub SSH keys, run:
  ansible-playbook playbooks/imports/optional/common/play-github-cli-multi.yml

Or specify a key manually:
  ccy --ssh-key ~/.ssh/<your-key>

Or log in with agent forwarding (ssh -A) and pass:
  ccy --ssh-agent

     | # ccy sources it inside the container, after ccy.env, so its values win.
     | #
